This is my own personal build distribution for BlueBubbles Server, containing a number of features, fixes, and polishes for testing.

Many of these changes can be found as pending PRs upstream, or will be submitted as PRs eventually.

This exists mainly for the purpose of quickly distributing macOS server builds so I can daily-drive the contributions.

**Unsigned build:** Gatekeeper will warn on first launch. Right-click the app → Open (or allow it in System Settings → Privacy & Security).
